locations.note: Violette blows up a German fuel depot on the Maginot Line, and at the end wakes from her coma in a French village hospital as an SS unit burns the villagers inside their church.
Violette slips into a Paris cathedral and assassinates a Nazi colonel.
During the Operation Gomorrah raids, Violette steals documents and marks a U-boat pen for the Allied bombers.
Hunting for three Allied agents, Violette crawls through Warsaw's sewers, finds one wounded and one dead of cyanide, and crosses the emptied ghetto.
Violette breaks into the Gestapo's Pawiak prison to slip cyanide to the third agent before he can be made to talk.

routes.name: Violette Summer
routes.note: From her hospital bed in France, Violette relives her missions on the Maginot Line, in Paris, Hamburg and the Warsaw Ghetto, and wakes as the SS reach her village.
